summary: Manages the definition, generation, and rendering of LLM context files, coordinating modular builders for thematic sections and formatting output into structured text.
responsibilities: Initialize and build LLM context definitions and structures
Generate LLM context files and data
Render LLM context data into structured text formats
relationships: LLM context builders construct thematic sections for context generation.
Markdown rendering transforms LLM context data into Markdown format.
